chunks: And the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله said:

Indeed, the sun and the moon are two signs from among the signs of Allah. They move according to His decree and end according to His command. They do not eclipse due to the death of anyone nor due to the life of anyone. So when one of them eclipses, hasten to your mosques.

key_terms.آيَتَانِ: two signs, indicating divine signs in creation
key_terms.أَمْرِهِ: His command, meaning Allah’s governing command
key_terms.اَلشَّمْسَ: the sun, presented here as one of Allah’s signs
key_terms.اَلْقَمَرَ: the moon, presented here as one of Allah’s signs
key_terms.بِتَقْدِيرِهِ: by His decree, meaning by Allah’s determined measure
key_terms.مَسَاجِدِكُمْ: your mosques, the places believers are told to hasten toward
key_terms.يَنْكَسِفَانِ: they eclipse, referring to the sun and moon undergoing eclipse

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله say about the meaning of solar and lunar eclipses?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that the sun and moon are among the signs of Allah and operate solely by His decree and command. It rejects superstitious beliefs that eclipses are caused by the death or life of human beings. It also directs believers to respond to an eclipse by hastening to the mosques for worship.
